headline: The US is banning foreign robots
summary: The US government is banning imports of “advanced robotic devices” and power inverters. The ban targets foreign countries, specifically China. It includes mobile robots like humanoid and quadruped models.

headline: Ariana Grande is suing the hackers who’ve been leaking her songs and videos for years
summary: Ariana Grande filed a lawsuit against unidentified hackers in Los Angeles. The suit aims to uncover the identities of individuals who stole and leaked her private content. Hackers are referred to as "John Doe 1 and John Does 2 through 100."

headline: The union drive at the Wikimedia Foundation is expanding
summary: UK staff at the Wikimedia Foundation began a unionization effort in June. US-based employees are now joining the union drive. Wikimedia management has declined to voluntarily recognize the US union.

headline: eBay’s bizarre cyberstalking saga ends with a $56 million settlement
summary: eBay and three former executives will pay $55.7 million in a settlement. The case involved a bizarre cyberstalking campaign against a Massachusetts couple in 2019. Former executives sent disturbing items, including live insects and a pig mask.

headline: Sony Battling Spider-Man: Brand New Day Post-Credit Scene Leaks, Scrubbing Social Media Via Copyright Claims
summary: Sony is actively battling significant leaks for Spider-Man: Brand New Day. The leaks specifically concern the movie's post-credits scene. Sony is using copyright claims to remove content from social media platforms.

headline: Tom Holland Reveals How He Brought Finishing Moves From Sony's Spider-Man Games to Brand New Day
summary: Tom Holland discussed taking inspiration from Sony’s Spider-Man games. Finishing moves from the games were incorporated into Brand New Day. Director Destin Daniel Cretton also detailed the combat translation.

headline: Fortnite Adds New Spider-Man, Hulk, and Punisher Skins in Brand New Day Crossover
summary: Fortnite is hosting a new crossover event. The event introduces new skins for Spider-Man, Hulk, and Punisher. This crossover ties into the Spider-Man: Brand New Day release.

headline: Halo: Campaign Evolved PC Settings Guide
summary: Halo: Campaign Evolved brings the classic game to Unreal Engine 5. A PC settings guide helps users optimize performance. Learn how to tweak graphics and other settings for the best experience.

headline: The moment Tuesday's powerful earthquake hit Japan
summary: A powerful earthquake struck Japan's Kyushu island on July 28. Video footage captures the moment the quake hit various locations. The region braced for significant impact and aftershocks.

headline: Some parents on benefits to get up to £4,500 for child starting apprenticeship
summary: Parents on benefits may receive up to £4,500 for their child starting an apprenticeship. The payment aims to compensate for potential income loss. This initiative supports families whose children pursue vocational training.

headline: Uefa and PM criticise Infantino World Cup plan
summary: Uefa and Prime Minister Andy Burnham have criticized Fifa's proposals. Fifa's plan involves seeking private investment for its competitions. The controversial plan includes the iconic World Cup tournament.

headline: Wildfires in south-west France flare up as region braces for new 40C heatwave
summary: Wildfires have flared up again in south-west France. Firefighters are preparing for a new 40C heatwave. Rising temperatures could severely complicate containment efforts in Gironde.
